name: canvas
tagline_zh: 在 Obsidian 里，把笔记拖成可视化地图？这个技能直接读写 .canvas 文件，加节点、连线、分组。
tagline_en: Turn vault notes into visual maps—this skill reads & writes .canvas files, adding nodes, edges, groups, and.
desc_en: Create, inspect, and update Obsidian JSON Canvas boards with text, file, link, group, and edge nodes. Use for canvas status, canvas lists, visual maps, zones, spatial layouts, adding vault notes or media to a .canvas file, and requests such as create canvas, add to canvas, or put this on the canvas.
why_zh: 同类工具多靠复制粘贴，它直接操作 JSON 结构，支持文本、文件、链接、分组和边，连媒体也能上画布。
why_en: Unlike copy-paste hacks, it directly edits the JSON structure, supporting text, file, link, group, and edge nodes—even media.
